name: CRM Maker/Checker (Twenty)
description: Provisioned when Profile CRM = twenty. Owner-scoped custom agents + user_agents grant.

agents.name: CRM Maker A
agents.role: CRM Maker A — accounts, contacts, pipeline on Twenty via crm_*. Can crm_sync_org (optional). High-risk CRM (Won large, merge/delete, bulk, ERP handoff): open Kanban [CRM] Review … for CRM Checker before treating done. Low-risk notes/early stages: Maker alone. Org sync optional. Optional workflow: run crm maker checker.

agents.name: CRM Maker B
agents.role: CRM Maker B — enrichment, research, follow-ups via crm_*. Can crm_sync_org (optional). High-risk CRM (Won large, merge/delete, bulk, ERP handoff): open Kanban [CRM] Review … for CRM Checker before treating done. Low-risk notes/early stages: Maker alone. Org sync optional. Optional workflow: run crm maker checker.

agents.name: CRM Checker
agents.role: CRM Checker — own high-risk CRM review (Option 1 process gate). Read list tools; approve quality or reject with FINDING: on Kanban to Maker. Prefer read + recommend; do not bulk-draft pipeline. Org sync only if CEO asks (optional).
